translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: TITO
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat a Tito c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In uchbil axi belom c’al a Cristo
Ca t’ilantha’ am belomchic quim putu c’al in uchbil c’al an oc’lecchic ani c’al an eyalchic. C’al in culbetal quin tolminchi c’al an they t’ojlab axi alhua’.
C’al ni jita’ yab ca quithab cahuilixin, ani c’al ni jita’ yab ca pejéxin. Quin t’aja’ ti c’aya’ inic c’al in at inic, ani c’al tim patal an inicchic quin t’aja’ ti maxu inic.

Huahua’ ti jayq’ui’ tam ti yabaye i belamal an Ajatic, yab i exla’ an chubaxtalab ani expith u jec’omac c’al a Dios. Ti jayq’ui’ u q’uibenec xe’etsac ani u huic’at co’oyame c’al yan i quithab le’nomtalab. I q’uijithnamal jahua’ yab alhua’. I t’ajchamal quithab an inicchic ani i pa’ixnamal. U pojcáxin jun c’al xi jun.
Aba ani’ pelac i ey antsana’ ti jayq’ui’, bel i Jec’onthaxil Dios tu tejhua’methanchi in alhua’ inictal ani in c’anithomtal.
Tu jec’onthamal a Dios cum tu yajnanchal ani yab abal i t’ajamalac jahua’ alhua’. Tu t’oquethanchamal i ichich ani tu it ejatlinchamal c’al an Espíritu Santo.
A Dios tu lej ts’ejhualith pithamalits an Espíritu Santo c’al tin ebal in t’ojlabil i Jec’onthaxil Jesucristo.
C’al tin ebal in alhua’ inictal a Dios jats tu tsu’tal tu bolith ani jats ti ne’ets cu c’uajiy abal ets’ey it ejatlith c’al jaja’ ti eb.

Lej chubax patal axe’ xi cau jahua’ nan tu uchal, Tito. Jats ca lej lubath t’iloxnanchi am belomchic, abal quin lej bina’ in ichich quin luba’ quin junini’ t’aja’ jahua’ alhua’. Ja’its in tomnal quin t’aja’chic, ani antsana’ ne’ets ca tabatna c’al patal in at inicchic in alhua’ t’ajbilchic.

Yab ca tolmiy ti t’ilom i inic ax in t’ilomnalq’ui i alq’uith cau axi yab jant’o ti alhua’ ani i lej nacat bijlab in ajumtal im biyal juntal. Yab ca tolmiy ax in le’ ti hueutsíxq’ui tin cuenta jahua’ in ulal an ts’ejcath cau axi pithnenec a Moisés c’al a Dios. Jolat ani yab jant’o ti alhua’ nixe’ xi t’ilomtalab.

Max hua’ats jita’ quin t’aja’ abal ca lehuáxin an tamcunel ebchalab, ca uchan ma tsabil abal yabats quin t’aja’. Max yab in le’ ti t’ajchi ti cuenta, tam ca lejat quethmayat ti al an tamcunel ebchalab.
Max in leye ti lehuáx, tam a tso’obits abal pel i q’uibelom inic ani ne’ets ca jolbiyat c’al in cuete’ hualab.

Ne’ets cu aba’ ca c’ale c’al tata’ a Artemas ani max iba a Tiquico. Tam ca ulits c’al tata’, ca luba’ max ca ejtou tiquin tamu ti Nicópolis. Taja’ u tsalpayamalits abal ne’ets cu huat’a’ an tsamay q’uij.
Ma ju’tam huichat ca ejtou, antsana’ ca tolminchi an ts’ejcaclome c’al an cau a Zenas ani jaye a Apolos. Cum ne’ets ti belal ca tolminchi c’al jahua’ quin yejenchichic.
Quin ujna’ an ebchalabchic ca alhua’ t’ojon abal yab quin co’oy i yejenchixtalab, ani jaye quin co’oy jant’o c’al ti quin tolmiy ax in cua’al i yejenchixtalab.

Ti abchalchic an tsapnethomtalab patal axi teje’ c’uajatchic c’al nana’. Ca tsapnetha’ am belomchic tihua’, cum pelits i lej le’nath ja’ubchic c’al a Cristo. U lej le’ abal a Dios ti lubach co’onchi a ichich patal tata’chic c’al in alhua’ inictal. Amén.
